name: dsh-voice-mode
description: Repository root manifest for dsh-voice-mode. The plugin itself lives in plugin/dsh-voice-mode and is published to npm from there; this root manifest exists so the community plugin market (dsh-plugin.org) can identify the package name and version when scanning this repository.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('不要在仓库根目录发布：npm 包在 plugin/dsh-voice-mode 下发布。'); process.exit(1)"
